groups.name: 辅弼
groups.note: Suited to assisting, counseling, and guiding work that doesn't grab the spotlight; cooperative environments that value coordination feel most natural.

groups.name: 魁钺
groups.note: Suited to roles where skill and ambition are visible, with influential people often nearby.

groups.name: 昌曲
groups.note: Arts and culture, atmosphere, analysis, and expression all fit; settings that value temperament and aesthetics bring out the best.

groups.name: 空劫
groups.note: Research and experimentation, chemistry and optics, healthcare, and design improvement, work that requires thought and a breakthrough, suit you.

groups.name: 火铃
groups.note: Suited to taking the initiative and to phase-driven work: pioneering, crafts, even challenging roles are manageable.

groups.name: 擎羊
groups.note: You like being out front. Foresight, metal and instruments, public order and justice, and reform work let you use your force.

groups.name: 陀罗
groups.note: Suited to work needing patience and repeated polishing; manufacturing and fine finishing show the real craft.

hua.禄: Easily brings people and matters along, with money and opportunities flowing with them.
hua.权: Able both to decide and to deliver; important matters are safe in your hands.
hua.科: Talent easily gets noticed; arts, presentation, and reputation all suit you.
hua.忌: You tend to hit the blocked point first; straightening out the dead corners and working through hard problems is where you grow.
